svg.text: Where New task sits before you scroll
Option B, compact bar. Gold box = stays put.
1 · New task lives in the bar, always (recommended)
One spot at rest and scrolled. Title row is just “Tasks”. Nothing swaps.
2 · New task beside the title at rest, joins the bar once the title scrolls off
Today's top stays as is. The button appears in the bar as the title leaves (a fade).
Both: on a phone Open | Done | All sits under the bar and scrolls away; the bar is search, Filters and +.
Bulk edit's Select all moves with New task. Tablet matches laptop, with a Filters button for the chips.
